alignments.note: Waw rendered by the connective *Moreover* (rule 14's open list read off the ASV).

Imperative rendered by the phrasal verb *take ... up*; discontinuous around the explicit pronoun under rule 25. Head stays on the lexical verb, since *up* is a phrasal particle and not a complement (rule 44).
Explicit independent pronoun takes its own *thou*; the verb keeps only its verb phrase.
Indefinite article belongs to the noun that licenses it (rule 15), not `added`.
Construct noun with no article morpheme present, so the supplied *the* goes to it (rule 29).
Nomen rectum takes the relational *of* and heads on the name (rules 19, 24).
